planTitle: Normalize CRM/system/inventory routed pages that still rely on line-based structure
summary: Refactored CRM, inventory, settings, and activity routed pages to replace hard border lines and structural dividers with tonal layering (`bg-surface-container-*`) and spacing. Replaced legacy table markup with shared `DataTable` primitive and updated typography/controls to inherit from the shared design system. Verified UI passes lint and builds successfully.
